context: A mom teaches her young son about manners
purpose: Teach: 何やら/思い込ん/思い込み/やさしく/今さら/間近/一同/礼儀

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日ケンくんが何やら泣いてたよ。
lines.en: Mom, Ken was crying at school today. I'm not sure why.
lines.style: Quiet, careful delivery. Small voice — Sho doesn't want to alarm, just report. Slight hesitation before naming the problem, as if checking that it's okay to bring it up.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Oh no. Do you know what happened?
lines.style: Gentle tilt toward her son. Open, unalarmed — she's not jumping to conclusions. Warm curiosity in the tone, inviting him to explain more.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: みんなが彼を、悪い子だって思い込んでて。
lines.en: Everyone kind of made up their minds that he's a bad kid. And now they won't give him a chance.
lines.style: Soft, almost to himself. Sho is working through the unfairness as he speaks. No accusation — just observation. Quiet conviction underneath the gentleness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それは思い込みかもね。やさしく声かけてあげるのが、礼儀の第一歩よ。
lines.en: That might just be what they've decided to believe. Being kind when you speak to him — that's where it starts.
lines.style: Patient, knowing tone. Not lecturing — teaching. She's speaking from certainty, but gently. A mother who knows her son needs permission to try something.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今さらかな?明日でも、僕、声かけたい。
lines.en: Is it too late for that? Even so — tomorrow, I want to talk to him.
lines.style: Earnest, with a slight question mark. Sho is testing whether his instinct is right. Then conviction settles in — he's made a decision. Softer on the second sentence, more resolute.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: クラス一同で、新学期間近に、もう一度仲良くなるチャンスだよ。
lines.en: You all have a fresh start coming with the new school year. This is your chance to know each other again.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging. Yumiko is opening a door for him — offering hope without pressure. Calm, steady rhythm. The tone of someone who believes in what she's saying and in him.
